title: dracocephalum fragrans
intro: Dracocephalum fragrans, commonly known as Dragon's Breath or Blue Dragon, is a perennial plant in the mint family known for its distinctive blue flowers and fragrant leaves. The plant is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Dracocephalum fragrans include analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant activities, making it a potential remedy for alleviating pain, relieving respiratory issues, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
